messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: elevated 5xx rate observed for aurora-sunset VPC canary (svc=rs-infer, pool=dedicated-aurora-canary). Paging on-call tess. https://alerts.internal/INC-7391

tess (oncall): ACK. I'm on it — checking dashboards and logs now. Pinging eng-runtime.

raj (eng-runtime): looking. Spike in worker exits + artifact fetch failures: "artifact checksum mismatch" during unpack on canary nodes. GPU OOMs follow shortly after.

linda (sre): Temporarily diverting incoming canary traffic for tenant aurora-123 to stable variant. Applying routing rule: route:canary->stable for org=aurora-123.

marcos (account-eng): Sophie (customer contact) is on call. Sophie, do you want us to stop canary traffic entirely or keep reads on stable?

sophie (customer-success): Please stop canary and keep prod on the stable artifact. Customers reported degraded responses. They'll prefer stability.

tess (oncall): Initiating pinned-artifact rollback to previous known-good sha. Command: `./infra/deploy revert --tenant aurora-123 --artifact sha256:abcd1234 --scope canary`

ops-bot: deploy job queued (job_id=7890). Worker pool: dedicated-aurora-canary. Estimated time ~3m.

raj (eng-runtime): Additional note: artifact in question was pushed 03:12 UTC by CI job 4421. Suspect upload corruption during registry mirror. Suggest blocking pulls from that artifact and re-ingesting.

linda (sre): Routing change complete. Canary traffic for aurora-123 diverted -> stable. Error rate for aurora-123 dropped to baseline within 30s. Confirming no new 5xx spikes on stable.

marcos (account-eng): Sophie says customer notified and content with rollback. I'll send an official incident update in 15.

raj (eng-runtime): Post-rollback steps: 1) quarantine artifact sha256:ef12dead (bad) from registry 2) re-run artifact verification job 3) add quick gating check to ingestion for mirrored registries.

tess (oncall): Handing to raj/linda for mitigation and postmortem. I'll stay available for escalation. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy job 7890 succeeded — canary nodes now running artifact sha256:abcd1234.

raj (eng-runtime): I'll own the RCA and follow-up with CI fix + registry checksum validation. Will add a runbook note about tenant isolation and pinned rollback for dedicated pools.

sophie (customer-success): Thanks team — customer appreciated the quick rollback and the clear next steps.

linda (sre): Closing page for now. If errors reoccur we re-open.

end of thread
